name: Remarrying The Same Person
overview: Scripture clearly addresses the issue of remarrying the same person after divorce, emphasizing God's design for marriage and the seriousness of divorce. Deuteronomy 24:4 forbids a man from taking back his former wife after she has been defiled, calling it an abomination before the Lord. Jesus reiterates the sanctity of marriage in Matthew 19:4, pointing back to the creation of male and female, and warns in Matthew 5:32 that marrying a divorced woman, except in cases of fornication, constitutes adultery. Jeremiah 3:1 uses the metaphor of unfaithfulness to illustrate the gravity of returning to a former spouse after they have been with another. These passages collectively uphold the permanence of marriage and caution against remarriage to the same partner following divorce.
